control.description-key: Draws the server-computed RAG status as an accessible dial. Contains no banding logic.

property.name: ragStatus
property.description-key: The server-computed band. Bind this to the RAG status column.

property.name: hoursRemaining
property.description-key: Signed hours remaining, computed on the server. Bind this to the Hours until SLA column.

property.name: horizonHours
property.description-key: How many hours remaining count as a full arc. Presentation only - changes nothing about the band.
